name: Don't Blink
oracle_text:
Until end of turn, if one or more creatures would enter from exile or after being cast from exile, their owners shuffle them into their libraries instead.
Cycling {2} ({2}, Discard this card: Draw a card.)
blocked_sentences: Until end of turn, if one or more creatures would enter from exile or after being cast from exile, their owners shuffle them into their libraries instead.

needs.what: a timed (until end of turn) replacement op on a spell for battlefield entry: if a creature would enter the battlefield from exile, or would enter as a resolving permanent spell that was cast from exile, it is instead shuffled into its owner's library; filtered by object type (Creature) and origin (exile zone or cast-from-exile), applying to all players
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The replacement vocabulary covers deaths (replace_deaths, replace_dies), leaving the battlefield (replace_leaves_battlefield), graveyard moves (replace_graveyard), draws, damage, counters, tokens and mill, but nothing replaces a permanent's entry to the battlefield with a different destination, and no selector or condition reads the zone a creature is entering from or whether its spell was cast from exile at the moment of entry; a permanent_enters delayed_trigger that shuffles afterward would let enters triggers and static effects happen, which the replacement prevents
